situation (example wording): "What are the ucr codes", "list nibrs offense codes in group b", "liat librs codes starting with 8", "What columns does the historical_agency_crime table have?"
what the app does today: The question is asked "which place?" although it names no crime, place or period.
proposed behavior: A question about the data itself (offense codes, table columns, which tabs hold a kind of data, what a code means) names no crime, place or period and is answered from fixed text or a fixed list. It is not asked 'which place'. The answer holds no counts. Code lists come from the FBI codebook; a prefix that matches no code answers that no code starts that way.
exact default or choices offered: Code lists: the current NIBRS offense codes from the FBI NIBRS User Manual 2025.0 (Group A with crime-against category, Group B arrest-only, retired Group B codes noted with their dates). Columns: the twelve columns of the historical agency crime table, one row per agency per year.
